The solution is in `main.rs`. It compiles, and a test run gave the expected output for both examples. I also fed it a blank line (skipped) and `2023-02-29` (not a leap year), which printed `invalid`. I didn't run any other inputs.

It treats a line as invalid unless it is exactly two whitespace-separated `YYYY-MM-DD` dates. A year outside 1900–2100 also prints `invalid`; the task doesn't say what
